title: HR Assistant Payroll & Benefits
description:
At Total Care Connections , our mission is to enrich lives by providing compassionate, high-quality home care that empowers individuals to live safely and independently. We believe that exceptional care begins with supporting the dedicated employees who make our mission possible. As a Payroll and Benefits Assistant, you play an essential role in ensuring our team members are paid accurately, have access to the benefits they need, and receive the timely support that helps them feel valued . Your attention to detail and commitment to service directly contribute to a positive employee experience, allowing our caregivers and staff to focus on delivering outstanding care to those we serve.
Position Summary
The HR Assistant supports the Payroll & Benefits Department by processing and validating employee information that feeds payroll and benefits administration. Serving as the first checkpoint in the payroll process, this role helps ensure employee changes are complete, accurate, approved, and submitted on time.
Key Responsibilities
Payroll and Employee Data Support
Validate time and attendance, PTO, leave, and employee records before each payroll cycle.
Process approved new hire, termination, compensation, transfer, promotion, and leave-of-absence changes.
Enter approved benefits deduction changes and maintain supporting documentation.
Conduct routine employee data audits, correct inaccuracies, and escalate unresolved discrepancies before payroll deadlines.
Provide the Payroll and Benefits Specialists with complete and accurate information for each processing cycle.
Employee Lifecycle And Benefits Support
Support onboarding and separation processes, including employee record setup, benefits eligibility, access-removal coordination, and required benefits continuation notifications.
Track benefits eligibility and enrollment milestones and maintain applicable eligibility lists.
Prepare employment verification letters and other routine employee correspondence.
Respond to general employee questions and escalate payroll or benefits concerns as appropriate.
International Payroll Support
Review international time and attendance records and support employee and contractor payment readiness.
Identify absences, unpaid time, missing information, and other payroll-impacting discrepancies before applicable deadlines.
Qualifications
One to two years of experience in HR administration, payroll support, benefits administration, or a related role.
Strong attention to detail, organization, and comfort working within recurring deadlines.
Experience using HR, payroll, benefits, timekeeping, or employee data-management systems.
Ability to handle confidential employee, payroll, and benefits information with discretion.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify discrepancies, and escalate issues appropriately.
Strong written communication skills and comfort supporting U.S. and international team members.
If our mission resonates with you and you're passionate about supporting the employees who make our care possible, we'd love to hear from you!

description:
Most short-form editors are trapped in volume millsâchurning out 50+ generic clips a day with zero creative input, and burning out in 3 months. We expect quality over mindless output, and actually want your creative ideas. If youâre an elite editor tired of being treated like a content factory, keep reading.

Edit short-form reels and podcast clips from raw creator content and interviews, identifying scroll-stopping moments that resonate with target audiences
Analyze trends in creator niches and propose fresh reel concepts tailored to each model's brand and personality
Ensure platform compliance (proper framing, audio, age-appropriate content)
Collaborate with creative team to refine edits based on feedback and achieve viral impact
REQUIREMENTS
Demonstrated short-form editing skill with a portfolio of approved, published Instagram/TikTok reels showing strong engagement and aesthetic quality (range and coachability weigh more than exact years)
Strong English (required) â the key language for communication and storytelling; we edit increasingly vlog-style content where English fluency directly shapes the edit. Spanish is a plus, not required.
Expert-level proficiency in CapCut â experience with DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro highly valued; must work on macOS (demonstrates commitment to professional-grade workflow and quality standards)
Can identify viral moments and execute polished, well-paced edits with strong hooks, clean captions, and purposeful text

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
30 days:
Daily output ramping toward ~20â25/day with 80%+ first-draft approval rate
Edits demonstrate understanding of brand voice and platform trends
Suggests 1+ format ideas per week
60 days:
Editing speed improves while maintaining quality standards
85%+ first-draft approval rate
Contributes 2+ trending format ideas per week
90 days:
90%+ first-draft approval rate (high proficiency across reel and podcast production)
Creates 1 original format used 5+ times by team across multiple creators
Demonstrates measurable creative impact on content performance
WHY BELLE MUSE?
A-players onlyâwork with elite editors who give a shit about quality
Your creative ideas actually matter (we want originals, not just copies)
Clear performance metricsâno guessing if youâre doing well
Professional standardsâmacOS workflows, real training, no drama

title: CFO Controller
description:
About Company
ADFAC, LLC is a private investment partnership with offices in Honolulu and Los Angeles. The firm is seeking a finance leader to support Hawaiian Cool Water, a Honolulu-based water treatment and equipment leasing company, along with related business interests.
This role offers the opportunity to serve as the primary financial partner to ownership while helping guide the company's financial operations and long-term planning.
The Role
ADFAC is seeking a Part-Time CFO / Controller to oversee the company's financial function, providing strategic financial guidance while remaining hands-on with day-to-day accounting and reporting. The position works closely with ownership to support financial planning, compliance, and operational decision-making.
This long-term remote engagement is designed for an experienced finance executive seeking meaningful impact with a flexible part-time schedule and responsibility for a single business.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Management
Lead the monthly financial close process and financial reporting.
Ensure GAAP compliance across accounting activities.
Develop budgets, rolling forecasts, and budget-to-actual analyses.
Manage fixed asset accounting and lessor accounting for equipment leasing operations.
Treasury & Financial Planning
Oversee banking relationships and cash management.
Monitor loan covenant compliance.
Partner with the external CPA firm on tax planning initiatives.
Leadership
Coach and develop the Accounting Specialist.
Serve as the primary financial advisor to ownership.
Support strategic financial decision-making and business planning.
Qualifications
CPA strongly preferred.
7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience.
Big Four/Five public accounting experience is a plus.
Hands-on controller experience with executive-level financial judgment.
Strong understanding of recurring revenue metrics, including MRR, churn, and margin.
Availability during Pacific or Hawaii business hours.
Compensation
$150â$165 per hour.
Long-term 1099 independent contractor engagement.
Time Commitment
Approximately 40â50 hours per month (9â12 hours per week).
Fully remote.
Flexible work schedule.
Training and transition support provided by the outgoing CFO/Controller.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
We are seeking a Social Media Strategist to build and grow a personality-led social media presence from the ground up.
This is a hands-on, end-to-end role covering strategy, account setup, content planning, production management, publishing, audience growth, community management, and performance optimization across Instagram and TikTok. You will work closely with the founder to establish a distinctive online identity and develop it into a recognizable, highly engaging social presence.
Responsibilities
Build and launch the Instagram and TikTok profiles from zero, including positioning, tone of voice, content pillars, visual direction, and channel strategy
Develop and execute the organic growth strategy, with a focus on reach, engagement, follower growth, and long-term audience development
Create viral campaign concepts, social-first stories, and repeatable content formats that establish a distinctive and recognizable online personality
Manage the full content lifecycle, including research, ideation, scripting, content calendars, production coordination, approvals, publishing, and optimization
Use platform analytics, audience insights, watch time, retention, and engagement data to guide creative decisions and improve performance
Manage day-to-day community engagement and coordinate with the founder and creative partners
Requirements
Proven experience launching and organically growing Instagram and TikTok accounts from an early or zero-follower stage
A strong portfolio of high-performing, viral, or culturally relevant social content supported by measurable growth results
Deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok algorithms, audience behavior, retention, discoverability, engagement, and organic growth mechanics
Strong creative strategy and social-first storytelling skills, with the ability to turn a personality into compelling and repeatable content
Hands-on experience managing social media end to end, from strategy and content development through production, publishing, analytics, and community management
Strong project management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with the founder and creative production partners
Able to work PST hours
Nice to Have
Experience working with creator-led brands, founders, entertainment properties, personality-driven accounts, legal brands, or character-led content is advantageous but not required

title: Maven Clinic: Design Lead, Consumer
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA; Remote, US
Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com
An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:
TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
Fortune Change the World (2024)
CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)
We have recently launched our direct-to-consumer platform that gives women access to GLP-1 care, hormone care, and 30+ healthcare specialties, connecting metabolic, hormonal, reproductive, mental, and physical health in one care experience. We are building for women who are tired of fragmented care, unclear pricing, limited follow-up, and healthcare experiences that treat each symptom or life stage in isolation.
About the role
We’re looking for a founding Product Design Lead to help build and scale Maven’s direct-to-consumer healthcare experiences.
This role sits at the intersection of consumer growth, healthcare access, product craft, AI-native ways of working, and trust-sensitive design.
It is a hands-on player-coach role with formal line management responsibility. You’ll lead a small team of senior Product Design/UXR practitioners while also owning high-priority product design work yourself.
You’ll report to the General Manager, Consumer and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Data, Clinical, Legal, Operations, and Support teams.
You will help Maven compete in a fast-moving and highly competitive consumer healthcare market while staying true to what makes Maven different: connected, clinically responsible, whole-person care for women.
You will be designing for users who are actively comparing options, making decisions quickly, weighing affordability, navigating uncertainty, and deciding whether they trust Maven enough to start and continue care.
The work will span both 0→1 product development and continuous optimization of live consumer journeys. You’ll help define new journeys, shape concepts, prototype, and bring new consumer healthcare offerings to market, while also improving existing funnels, onboarding, eligibility, pricing, payment, prescription, activation, retention, and cross-sell experiences through research, experimentation, data, and design craft.
What we’re looking for
You may be a strong fit if you have:
7+ years of product design experience, including complex consumer product journeys and 0→1 product growth.
Experience formally managing or leading design teams.
Strong hands-on product design craft across UX, prototyping, visual design, mobile apps, and responsive web.
A portfolio showing D2C product design leadership, systems thinking, data-driven decision-making, high-quality execution, and measurable product impact.
Experience designing products where trust, comprehension, eligibility, pricing, access, personal data, or complex decision-making play a central role.
Experience with growth, onboarding, conversion, activation, retention, cross-sell, monetization, or lifecycle journeys, informed by research, data and experimentation.
A strong AI-native workflow and informed opinions on how AI can improve design quality, team capacity, and business value.
We’d especially love to see
Experience in healthcare, women’s health, telehealth, digital health, insurance, fintech, marketplaces, consumer subscriptions, or another regulated or trust-sensitive domain.
Experience designing products involving insurance, benefits, prescriptions, clinical eligibility, payments, care navigation, or personal health information.
Experience designing in a competitive direct-to-consumer category where acquisition, conversion, trust, differentiation, and retention all matter.
Location and working model
This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States, with a strong preference for those based in San Francisco.
The base salary range for this role is $195,000-$230,000 per year. You will also be entitled to equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.
Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA, Boston, MA, Chicago, IL, and Washington, D.C., we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend quarterly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.
At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.
Benefits That Work For You
Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:
Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days
16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting
These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.
Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com .

Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Hi, I'm Matt Lane, Manager of Account Management at Customer.io , and I'm looking for an Account Manager to join our EMEA team. This is a revenue ownership role — you'll manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts, driving renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and building the kind of relationships that make customers want to grow with us. You'll be part of a tight-knit EMEA team and a key commercial voice for the accounts you own.
This role is open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland only.

Commercial ownership — you treat your book of business like it's yours, because it is
Forecasting discipline and data-driven decision-making, not gut feel

Expansion through value, not feature gates or mechanical levers

Own the full commercial strategy for a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts — renewals, expansion, and churn mitigation
Drive growth by helping customers adopt Customer.io more strategically, identifying new use cases and articulating ROI clearly

3+ years in Account Management, Sales, or a related SaaS commercial role with direct ownership of a revenue number (5+ years preferred)

A forecasting methodology you can walk through clearly — it doesn't need to be a named framework, just logic you own

title: RETR: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://retr.app/
Why this role matters now
A loan officer's business runs on relationships. Ours runs on making sure RETR never gets in the way of theirs.
When something breaks for a customer, a real deal is on the line, and what they need is a person who understands both the product and their business. That person is you.
Most support jobs are a treadmill: you answer the question, the question comes back, you answer it again. Here the work compounds. A good answer becomes an article, the article teaches our AI, and the question stops coming. We measure which articles resolve and which fail, so you can watch the queue shrink because of something you wrote.
What you'll do
• Be the first human a customer talks to, across email, chat, and phone, for individual and enterprise accounts alike
• Answer the hard half. Our AI handles the routine questions; what reaches you is the ambiguous, the technical, and the high-stakes
• Write and improve the knowledge base articles that make the AI better and the queue smaller. We measure which articles resolve and which fail, and we fix the ones that fail
• Build real fluency in mortgage and real estate workflows, deep enough to explain our product in the customer's language rather than ours
• Take actions that carry weight: refunds, cancellations, and billing corrections in Stripe
• Surface product friction to Engineering with enough evidence that it gets fixed, then tell the customer when it ships
• Hand inbound leads to Sales cleanly. Support does not sell, but Support is often the first to touch a future enterprise deal
The first 90 days
Two things in this job reach customers at scale without a human in between: the knowledge base, which feeds our AI, and our enterprise accounts. A knowledge base article that is 80 percent right makes the AI wrong for everyone who asks. So neither one is handed to you on a calendar date. Both are handed over when you have earned them.
Days 1 to 14. Product and customer mastery. Learn what every search does and why a customer would use it. Read every knowledge source we have. Study the queue, open and closed. Start answering emails and chats.
Days 15 to 30. Triage with ease. Route what you cannot answer to the right place. Start taking phone calls, which demand faster answers than anything written.
Day 30. You can run the inbox alone, handle refunds and cancellations, and walk a customer through troubleshooting without help. You will run a mock demo of the platform with your manager playing the customer.
Day 60. You start owning knowledge base articles. If a customer asks something twice, you write it.
Day 90. Full coverage, including enterprise, to the white-glove standard those customers expect. The test that matters: your manager can be offline for a week and nothing breaks.
We would rather ramp you properly than throw you at enterprise in week three and apologize to a customer for it.
The team
Two people. You report to our Customer Support Manager. She reports to our COO. That is the org.
You will also work directly with Engineering on bugs and escalations, with Customer Enablement on onboarding, and with Sales on inbound leads. We are twelve people. Everyone reaches across.
The stack
• Support. HubSpot for tickets, SLAs, and reporting. Aircall for phone. Stripe for billing.
• AI. An AI agent handling first-line resolution, tuned against a knowledge base you will help own.
• Product. The RETR platform: search, lists, exports, alerts, and enterprise account management.
What we're looking for
• 1 to 3 years in a customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
• Genuine patience and real critical thinking. Most of what reaches you will not have an obvious answer
• You explain the why behind an issue rather than just the fix, because that is what builds trust
• Sharp attention to detail in how you document requests, troubleshooting steps, and interactions, plus the instinct to see a problem before it lands
• You would rather fix the root cause than close the ticket
• Comfort with support tooling and a willingness to learn new systems quickly
• Curiosity about AI as a tool you shape, not a threat you resent. A meaningful part of this job is making the machine better
Bonus. Familiarity with the mortgage or real estate industry, or another regulated and technical field.
How we operate
Three philosophies we run by:
• Give more than you get.
• Lead with value.
• Do the right thing.
Five values behind them: Honesty. Integrity. Fairness. Accountability. Excellence.
You'll love this job if you already operate this way. If you don't, we're not the right fit for you.
“Give more than you get” is the one that shows up most in this job. It is the difference between answering the question a customer asked and answering the question they were actually trying to solve. We may not always be able to go the extra mile, but we can always go the extra inch.
What we offer
• $52,000 to $58,000 base salary. National band, no geo-adjustment
• Fully remote, US-based
• Medical Insurance
• Dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability employer-provided
• 401(k) with match: 100% of your first 1% plus 50% of your next 5%
• 15 days PTO plus 13 paid holidays, including Christmas Eve and the day after Thanksgiving
• $100 weekly meal stipend, $100 monthly wellness stipend
• Full home office setup: laptop, monitors, camera, peripherals provided
What we don't offer
• Big-tech RSUs. We're bootstrapped. No stock grants.
• Bureaucracy. We're small and we like it that way.
• A ticket queue you disappear into. What you learn from customers reaches the people who build the product, in the same week.
• A script to hide behind. Our customers are people building businesses, not numbers in a queue, and we answer them that way.
How to apply
Send a resume and a short note to jobs@retr.app answering one question: tell us about a question you got asked so many times that you did something about it. What did you change, and did it work?
We read every application. If there's a fit, we'll set up a conversation.
We're an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
More at retr.app.

About the role
As our Sr. Demand Generation Manager , you'll be essential in achieving TestGorilla's vision of helping one billion people land their dream job. You'll own our largest acquisition lever, a multi-six-figure monthly Google Ads investment, along with the lifecycle, enrichment, and website systems that turn that spend into revenue. This isn't just a role, it's your chance to make a real difference by proving, with data, that every dollar of spend becomes pipeline. You'll directly contribute to sustainable, cost-efficient growth as TestGorilla scales.
Responsibilities
In this role, your responsibilities will include but not limited to:
Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.
Owning the demand generation number across paid and organic channels, including managing and scaling paid spend across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) and adjacent channels, while testing and developing emerging acquisition opportunities such as advertising on ChatGPT and other AI-native platforms. Setting the channel mix, budget allocation, and account structure required to hit MQL, SQO, and pipeline targets.
Building and owning source-of-truth reporting across paid and organic funnel performance, including SQL, dashboards, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing, so channel investment decisions are backed by evidence rather than platform screenshots.

Designing and owning automated nurture workflows and enrichment infrastructure (n8n, Make, HubSpot, Clay) so paid-sourced leads convert, and feeding that data back into targeting and ICP decisions.
Partnering with Sales and RevOps on lead quality and conversion by campaign, and presenting performance and recommendations to marketing and GTM leadership in clear, business-first language.

What you’ll bring

Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.
Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Thrives in a fast-paced, async-first, remote-only environment.
Has proven experience in performance or growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of a Google Ads budget of at least six figures per month (B2B SaaS strongly preferred), and a track record of scaling spend while holding or improving CAC and ROAS.
We typically expect 7+ years of experience in performance or growth marketing to have developed the core skills necessary for this position. But it may be more or less than that, according to your career journey so far.
Has deep expertise across the Google Ads stack, including Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Smart Bidding, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager.
Working knowledge and hands-on expertise of Clay, HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and GA suite.
Has a solid grasp of funnel and unit economics (CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, payback period, cohort analysis) and comfort with experimentation design, including significance, sample sizing, and reading results honestly.
Has hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build real growth workflows, from lead scoring to automation logic, not just surface-level use.
Has an ownership mentality: treats this budget like their own P&L, ships the workflow, dashboard, and test themselves, and is comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration as pipeline needs shift.
We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply.
Bonus skills
While these skills aren’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have:
Experience managing an agency or freelancers alongside in-house execution.
Exposure to PLG or hybrid PLG/sales-led GTM.
Experience presenting to VP/C-level stakeholders on performance and budget.
Experience owning SEO or content-led demand generation programs alongside paid channels.
Has strong working SQL, fluency in GA4 and at least one BI tool
What’s in it for you?

Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world
Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive pay (€65,650-€84,500 per annum) + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs)
Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.

Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities
Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches
Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being
Interested?
At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true potential. Forget traditional biases; we're building the world's largest skills-tested talent pool, making hiring fairer, faster, and smarter for everyone!
When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment – it's your chance to shine and show us what you can do! title: MobiLoud: Account Executive
description:
Headquarters: London, England
URL: https://www.mobiloud.com
Work location: Remote, anywhere outside the United States
Sales territory: North America, UK, and EU
Contract type: Full-time contractor
Compensation: Competitive base plus commissions tied to closed revenue
About MobiLoud
MobiLoud helps established ecommerce brands turn their existing websites into iOS and Android apps, without rebuilding their product or running a second system.
Our customers use MobiLoud to drive repeat purchases, recover abandoned carts through push notifications, and reduce their dependence on paid acquisition.
We're a bootstrapped, profitable, remote-first SaaS company founded in 2013. We've published 2,000+ apps and have hundreds of active customers today, including Estee Lauder, John Varvatos, Jack & Jones, and Tadashi Shoji. Our team is 16 people, all remote and hands-on.
The Role
Email and SMS still drive revenue for ecommerce brands, but deliverability, SMS compliance, and acquisition costs keep making retention harder. A mobile app gives their best customers another direct channel through push notifications, tied to the website they already operate. That is the sale.
You own the close for ecommerce brands across North America, the UK, and Europe. Discovery, demo, proposal, pricing conversations, contracting, and getting the signature on the order form are all part of the job.
Most buyers are founders, ecommerce leads, digital directors, and marketing leaders. This is an inbound-led closing role: meetings come mainly from inbound demand, SDR-sourced pipeline, older opportunities, and referrals. You turn the right opportunities into signed customers.
This posting is for candidates based outside the United States. You can be anywhere if you can work with UK/EU hours and have regular overlap with US East Coast business hours for demos and buyer conversations. You need to sound natural with North American and European buyers, understand how DTC ecommerce brands think, and learn the mobile app revenue case quickly.
What You'll Do
• Run discovery with inbound and SDR-sourced prospects
• Lead demos tied to the prospect's site, traffic, retention stack, and commercial goals
• Build the proposal, pricing case, and ROI narrative
• Run pricing and commercial conversations
• Manage the contracting process through signature and handoff
• Follow up on stalled deals and re-engage older good-fit opportunities
• Keep the CRM current, with clear next steps, close dates, and deal notes
Who You Are
• You have closed B2B deals before and can talk clearly about deal size, sales cycle, buyer type, win rate, objections, and what you personally owned
• You have SaaS or software sales experience, ideally with products that require some technical understanding: websites, integrations, ecommerce platforms, apps, implementation, or developer-adjacent work
• You have native or near-native English. Written and spoken English both need to feel natural to US, Canadian, UK, and EU buyers
• You understand North American business culture, buying expectations, consumer brands, ecommerce, DTC, and how senior buyers like to communicate
• You can sell to founders, heads of digital, ecommerce leads, and marketing leaders without sounding scripted
• You are comfortable learning both the commercial and technical side of ecommerce: retention, repeat purchase, owned channels, paid acquisition pressure, websites, mobile apps, integrations, and why brands invest in apps
• You can work with UK/EU hours and have regular overlap with US East Coast business hours for demos and buyer conversations
Compensation
• Competitive base plus commissions tied to closed revenue
• Full-time independent contractor basis. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax obligations
• You may be based anywhere outside the United States. MobiLoud pays in USD
Why This Role
• You sell to established ecommerce brands with real revenue and clear commercial problems
• Direct line to the founder. Deal review, pricing decisions, and feedback happen quickly
• You work on apps for brands like Estee Lauder, John Varvatos, Jack & Jones, and Tadashi Shoji
• Remote contractor role with competitive USD compensation, commission upside, and no office requirement
• Set your own hours and take unlimited time off. Give notice when you're out, that's the only rule
Not a Fit If
• You are based in the United States
• You have not closed B2B deals before
• You have not personally sold software or SaaS before
• Your English is good but still too formal, scripted, or unnatural for North American buyers
• You do not follow ecommerce, DTC brands, North American consumer culture, or how online brands grow
• You need close daily management to stay focused
How to Apply
Email jobs@mobiloud.com with the subject line Account Executive - MobiLoud.
Include:
• Where you are based, and how your working day overlaps with UK/EU and US East Coast business hours
• A recent B2B software or SaaS deal you personally closed: what you sold, who the buyer was, deal size, sales cycle, and what you owned from discovery through signature
• How many new-logo B2B deals you personally closed in the last 12 months
• One ecommerce or DTC brand you think could sell well through a mobile app, and why
• Your CV and LinkedIn profile
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mobiloud-account-executive

title: Temporal Technologies: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
Headquarters: United States - Remote Opportunity
About Us
Temporal is an open source programming model that can simplify code, make applications more reliable, and help developers focus on the important things like delivering features faster. We are on a mission to be the reliable foundation of every developer’s toolbox, and are building the team that will make that happen.
Our values guide us —they are present in how we show up, make decisions, and work together to make an impact. We’re curious, driven, collaborative, genuine and humble.
Temporal is growing and we are looking for those who share our values, challenge 'standard' thinking, and want to influence our future. If you have a passion for improving the developer experience, building world-class open-source software and communities, and want to be a part of our amazing team, we'd love to hear from you!
Summary
Temporal is at an interesting point — growing fast, expanding globally, and building the finance infrastructure to match. AP is a high-volume, high-accountability function here: a large and growing vendor base, multi-currency transactions, and a steady stream of inquiries from across the business. We need someone who takes pride in keeping all of that running cleanly, on time, every cycle — without being asked.
You’ll own full-cycle AP in Bill.com, manage vendor relationships, administer the expense program in Navan, and be the go-to for payment questions from Finance, HR, Legal, and the broader business. This role is for someone who is deeply organized and self-directed.
What You'll Do
Full-Cycle AP Operations
Own end-to-end invoice processing in Bill.com — intake, GL coding, 2-way and 3-way PO matching, approval routing, and payment execution via ACH, wire, check, and international wire
Review and reconcile vendor statements monthly; identify and resolve discrepancies, duplicate payments, and open credits in a timely manner
Manage payment runs on a consistent schedule; ensure all payments are properly authorized, documented, and recorded in Rillet (our GL system of record)
Own 1099 preparation and filing — maintain W-9s and TIN documentation throughout the year, produce accurate 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC filings, and respond to IRS notices as needed
Process invoices across multiple legal entities as international subsidiaries come online — apply the correct entity, currency, and intercompany treatment to each transaction
Support prepaid schedule tracking and AP accrual entries as part of month-end close; flag unprocessed invoices and ensure the books reflect actual obligations
Vendor Management
Onboard new vendors from end to end — collect W-9s and banking information, set up vendor records in Bill.com, verify payment details before the first disbursement
Maintain the vendor master with current payment instructions, contact details, and tax documentation; audit the vendor list periodically to identify inactive or duplicate records
Serve as the primary point of contact for vendor payment inquiries — respond accurately and promptly, and escalate disputes or discrepancies to the appropriate internal stakeholder
Monitor and manage the AP inbox; triage incoming invoices, statements, and vendor correspondence so nothing falls through the cracks
T&E and Expense Management
Administer the employee expense reimbursement process in Navan — review submissions for policy compliance, coding accuracy, and required receipts; approve or flag exceptions consistently
Manage the corporate card program in coordination with Finance and HR — handle card issuance and termination, monitor spend against policy, and reconcile card transactions monthly
Identify recurring policy violations or process friction and bring solutions to the Senior Accounting Manager — the expense process should get cleaner every quarter, not stay the same
Prepare monthly T&E reporting and variance analysis for department heads and Finance leadership
Month-End Close
Prepare and post AP accrual journal entries in Rillet; ensure all invoices received but not yet processed are captured before close
Reconcile the AP subledger to the GL monthly; investigate and resolve any variances before books are closed
Review aged payables and unapplied credits; proactively resolve items before they age beyond 60 days
Support the annual EY audit by preparing AP aging schedules, vendor reconciliations, payment support, and any other documentation requested by auditors
What You’ll Need
3+ years of full-cycle accounts payable experience; prior experience at a high-growth tech company is a strong plus
Proven ability to manage high invoice volume without losing accuracy — you stay organized, hit payment deadlines consistently, and keep the queue clear
Hands-on experience with Bill.com or a comparable AP automation platform (Tipalti, Airbase, or similar); Bill.com experience is strongly preferred given that’s what we run
Experience administering a T&E or expense platform — Navan, Concur, Expensify, or similar; you've audited expense reports and enforced a policy, not just processed reimbursements
Experience with a modern cloud ERP — Rillet, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or equivalent; you understand how AP flows into the general ledger and what a clean subledger looks like
Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills — you're comfortable building reconciliations, pivot tables, and AP aging analysis from scratch without a template
Working knowledge of 1099-NEC/MISC reporting requirements, W-9 collection and TIN matching, and the basics of sales/use tax applicability
Comfortable holding the line on expense policy — you can tell an employee their submission doesn’t meet policy clearly and without drama, and you don’t cave under pushback
Clear, proactive communication across functions — Finance, HR, Legal, and vendors all need different things from AP, and you know how to calibrate
High attention to detail and genuine ownership mentality — AP errors have downstream consequences for vendors, the close, and the audit, and you take that seriously
Experience with a procure-to-pay or spend management platform such as Zip, Coupa, Airbase, or Ramp
Preferred:
Multi-entity or multi-currency AP experience — you've processed invoices across legal entities and know how intercompany and FX coding work in practice
Experience supporting a financial statement audit — you’ve prepared AP schedules, aging reports, and reconciliations for external auditors and know what clean documentation looks like
Compensation
The estimated pay range for this role is $100,000 - $150,000 depending on experience and location.
Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Temporal’s equity plan.

title: Amwell: Customer Success Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US
Company Description
At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.
We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.
We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum , including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.
For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.
Brief Overview
We are looking for an experienced, passionate Customer Success Manager (CSM) with excellent relationship building & project management skills to join the team. The CSM will leverage deep customer relationships, key data insights, and a broad knowledge of Amwell’s products and processes to drive increased satisfaction, adoption, and customer retention.
CSMs partner closely with customers in their assigned book of business throughout the customer lifecycle to:
· Help them to maximize the benefits of their Amwell product portfolio
· Work with them to define, track and achieve goals & KPIs
· Proactively identify solutions & overcome barriers to satisfaction
· Achieve greater product adoption & utilization
· Advocate to ensure that all departments within Amwell are aligned to meet their needs
Core Responsibilities
· Proactively build strong relationships with customer contacts at each level of the customer organization throughout the entire partnership
· Understand and help measure customers’ individual business goals and KPIs to develop tailored proactive outreach as appropriate, including provider engagement, product consulting, use case optimization and proactive monitoring of support issues
· Collaborate closely with Account Directors to provide Executive Business Reviews and ensure strategic alignment with the customer’s goals and Amwell experience
· Partner closely with Implementation Managers during project phase to ensure a smooth post-go live transition
· Move customers along the lifecycle from adoption to proficiency with the Amwell product suite, while continuing to foster growth of the product adoption.
· Leverage expert knowledge of Amwell’s software, hardware, and clinical product offerings to help customers get the most from their contracted products, including advising customers on best practices, consulting on configuration options, and communicating new product features that could benefit the customer’s business
· Proactively engage with key client stakeholders to understand pain points and best practices, provide personalized training where needed, and gather feedback on Amwell’s products
· Collaborate with internal teams to design a roadmap of future product adoption for each customer, including migrations
· Be a champion for documentation and alignment across internal & external stakeholders, a true customer-facing advocate with the skills and passion of a project manager
· Maintain internal CRM (Gainsight) to track customer health and activity, proactively identify trends & potential risks, and to provide greater visibility to the internal organization about the customer and their needs
· Act as a central point of communication for support ticket escalations, responding with a sense of urgency and owning external messaging for escalations, while partnering with the Customer Support internal liaison
· In general, work cross-functionally with Account Management, Sales, Customer Support, Product, Professional Services, and Solution Design to drive a successful overall customer relationship
Qualifications
· A bachelor’s degree or equivalent
· 4+ years of relevant experience in customer success in a SaaS environment
· Experience working in healthcare technology
· Excellent project management skills
· A ‘customer first’ mindset and passion for delivering a delightful customer experience
· Comfortable understanding and explaining software products to diverse audiences
· Excellent verbal and written communication skills
· Excellent project management skills, time management, and ability to remain calm and resilient in high pressure situations
· High energy level, enthusiastic, and eager to do what is necessary to be successful
· Gainsight and Salesforce proficiency preferred
Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell.
Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.
Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members.
We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.
Benefits
Flexible Personal Time Off (Vacation time)
401K match
Competitive healthcare, dental and vision insurance plans
Paid Parental Leave (Maternity and Paternity leave)
Employee Stock Purchase Program
Free access to Amwell’s Telehealth Services, SilverCloud and The Clinic by Cleveland Clinic’s second opinion program
Free Subscription to the Calm App
Tuition Assistance Program
Pet Insurance
Salaried, Exempt Roles
The typical base salary range for this position is $93,690 - $114,510. The actual salary offer will ultimately depend on multiple factors including, but not limited to, knowledge, skills, relevant education, experience, complexity or specialization of talent, and other objective factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and employee performance. title: Yoko Co: Front-End WordPress Developer
description:
Headquarters: McLean, VA
URL: https://www.yokoco.com/
We’re seeking a Front-End Developer who wants to make the world a better place through clean code, thoughtful craftsmanship, and a genuine love of building great websites.
This isn’t just about turning designs into code, it’s about translating ideas into experiences, solving problems along the way, and taking pride in the details that make a site feel right. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys the craft of front-end development, cares about doing things the right way, and is always looking for a better, more efficient way to build.
Why work at Yoko Co?
Do good, better: We exclusively serve clients who make a positive impact on the world. This is your chance to build things that help create a better place for all of us.
4-day flex week and lots of holidays. Mondays are flex days, meaning you’re free to take them off if you’re caught up on your work. Plus, we’re closed for nearly a full week at Thanksgiving (November), and two weeks at the end of the year, plus a bunch of other days, too.
High performance, no jerks. You’ll collaborate with good people who believe in doing great work. Best Place to Work (and that’s not just our opinion).
We’ve been named a Best Place to Work by the Inc. 5000 and Washington Business Journal. We value team members who are motivated by our mission and driven to make a positive impact.
If you have a passion for excellence, a growth mindset, and a commitment to collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.
What you’ll do:
As part of our development team, you’ll build websites and features from design references, turning Figma files into clean, maintainable, production-ready code. Our primary stack is built on Gutenberg block themes, so you’ll spend most of your time there, though you may also work on traditional WordPress themes and, occasionally, other page builders.
Build websites and site features from design references, using industry-standard code and best practices
Develop and maintain WordPress block themes using Gutenberg, templates, parts, patterns, and theme.json configuration
Work with traditional WordPress themes when needed, and occasionally with other page builder platforms
Write clean, well-structured HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Build or extend front-end functionality using React or similar component-based approaches when the project calls for it
Use Git and GitHub for version control, following team branching and code review conventions
Work within a continuous deployment workflow, ensuring changes move smoothly and safely from development to production
Troubleshoot cross-browser and cross-device issues to ensure consistent, polished results
Collaborate with designers, project managers, and strategists to bring projects to life
Look for new and more efficient ways to deliver our work, whether that’s through better tooling, reusable components, or refined processes
Contribute to internal documentation, component libraries, and knowledge sharing
Stay current with WordPress, Gutenberg, and front-end development trends and best practices
What we’re looking for:
We’re less concerned with rigid checklists and more interested in capable, thoughtful developers who care about quality and enjoy solving problems. Strong candidates typically have:
Fluency in WordPress, with experience building both traditional themes and Gutenberg block themes
Comfort working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript Experience translating design references (Figma or similar) into accurate, responsive, production-ready code
Familiarity with Git workflows and collaborative development practices
Experience working within a continuous deployment or CI/CD pipeline
Experience working with tools like Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex
An eye for detail and a commitment to clean, maintainable code Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Fluent English for written and spoken communication
Bonus points:
Experience building custom Gutenberg blocks
Experience with React or similar component-based frameworks
Experience working in a multi-client or agency environment
You may not want to apply if…
You prefer 100% concrete specs handed to you with no ambiguity and no changes. We do our best to provide final, locked designs and specs, but things inevitably change as a project progresses
You’re not interested in learning or working within Gutenberg block themes
You’d rather work solo than collaborate with designers, PMs, and strategists
You’re reluctant to incorporate AI into your workflow
Front-end development here is a mix of code and configuration, and often requires curiosity, flexibility, and a willingness to find the most efficient path to a great result.
What you get:
You’ll get a flexible schedule, unlimited time off, a competitive salary, a profit share bonus (starting in your second year), the ability to work wherever you want, a personal development budget, and all US federal holidays and multiple weeks off at the end of the year to recharge. We’ll also offset your entire carbon footprint. If you’re in the US, we also offer health insurance, disability and life insurance, and 401(k) matching.
More about us:
We’re a group of people who are passionate about the work we do, the clients we serve, and improving our craft. We also care about each other — we don’t think of one another as coworkers or employees, but as fellow humans. From developers to designers, project managers to strategists, we bring out the best in each other.
We’ve been in business for over a decade, our whole team is remote, and we’ve been named a Best Place to Work by the Inc. 5000 and the Washington Business Journal.
To apply:
If you’re interested, fill out our application form . An actual human from our team looks at every submission. As much as we’d like to, we can’t promise that we’ll reply to every application.
P.S. We encourage you to include a video message!
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/yoko-co-front-end-wordpress-developer

description:

This role will be responsible for driving operational excellence across the revenue engine, enabling predictable, efficient growth across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments. This role will also oversee Marketing Operations, ensuring alignment between demand generation, pipeline creation, and revenue outcomes across the full customer lifecycle.
This leader will own revenue planning, forecasting, revenue operations, incentives, systems, analytics, and GTM infrastructure. Partnering closely with Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Customer leadership, this role will play a critical role in strengthening execution rigor, improving forecast accuracy, and enabling Dropbox to scale across products, regions, and sales motions, including product-led, sales-assisted, and enterprise.

Requirements
12+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Operations, Finance, or related functions within a scaled SaaS or product-led growth company
Proven experience leading revenue operations for multi-segment B2B organizations across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise customer segments
Deep expertise in forecasting, revenue planning, territory design, quota management, sales productivity, incentive compensation, and pipeline management
Strong understanding of SaaS business models, revenue motions, and key operational drivers across acquisition, expansion, and retention
Demonstrated ability to identify operational challenges and implement scalable, data-driven solutions that improve business performance
Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Customer organizations
Experience supporting organizations through significant growth and GTM evolution, including PLG, sales-assisted, and enterprise motions
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with extensive experience leveraging data to drive operational and business decisions
Track record of building, developing, and leading high-performing revenue operations teams in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Preferred Qualifications
Proven track record implementing AI-enabled revenue solutions that deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, productivity, and business outcomes
Demonstrated experience owning and scaling GTM technology ecosystems, with deep expertise in Salesforce and related revenue platforms

title: Collibra: Director, Facility Security Officer
description:
Headquarters: Remote, East Coast USA
Joining Collibra Public Sector LLC (CPS)
Collibra Public Sector LLC (CPS) is a DCSA-cleared entity operating under an approved Proxy Agreement (PA) and Affiliated Operations Plan (AOP) as a FOCI-mitigated subsidiary. The Director, Facility Security Officer (FSO) will serve as the principal security advisor to CPS’s Government Security Committee (GSC) and the company's primary interface with the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) and other cognizant security authorities. Additionally, the Director will be responsible for developing, implementing, and ensuring compliance with our Insider Threat Program and be the designated FSO and Insider Threat Security Officer (ITPSO).
This is a foundational leadership role within CPS. The Director will own the ongoing execution and maturation of CPS’s policies in accordance with the National Industrial Security Program. The Director will ensure full compliance with the PA and AOP between CPS and the parent company. The FSO reports to the CPS General Manager and operates under the oversight of the GSC. This role requires independence and a thorough understanding of the obligations that govern FOCI-mitigated entities, facility clearances, and personnel clearances.
The Director, Facility Security Officer is responsible for
FOCI Compliance and Proxy Agreement Execution
Serve as principal advisor to the GSC on all matters related to the PA compliance and any other applicable matters.
Maintain and enforce all obligations under the approved PA and APO, including visit controls, the Electronic Communications Plan, and the Technology Control Plan.
Serve as the primary point of contact with DCSA for all matters related to facility clearances, annual compliance reporting, and all FOCI mitigation oversight.
Review and approve all affiliate contacts, visits and communications between CPS and the parent company in accordance with the approved visit controls procedures.
Develop and maintain a FOCI mitigation instrument (Security Control Agreement, Special Security Agreement, or equivalent) in coordination with outside counsel on FOCI mitigation matters and any open compliance questions.
Establish and maintain all required DSS/DCSA-mandated records, plans, and programs.
Personnel Security
Administer personnel security clearance processing end-to-end via JPAS/DISS, including nominations, investigations, and visit certifications.
Advise employees and managers on clearance eligibility, adjudicative guidelines, and ongoing reporting obligations.
Maintain a current and accurate roster of cleared personnel and access authorizations.
Insider Threat & Security Education
Lead Collibra's Insider Threat Program, including a multi-disciplinary hub and reporting mechanisms.
Develop and deliver annual and ongoing security education and awareness training for cleared and uncleared personnel.
Conduct self-inspection programs and prepare for DCSA facility reviews and annual compliance audits.
Governance & Stakeholder Management
Serve as a trusted advisor to the General Manager and the GSC senior leadership on all security and compliance matters related to the government business.
Partner with independent legal counsel on export control compliance, including ITAR/EAR obligations as they intersect with CPSs products and services.
Support contract compliance and bid activities requiring security documentation or clearance certifications.
Coordinate incident investigations involving potential unauthorized disclosure, fraud, or insider threat, and ensure prompt reporting to GSC and DCSA as required.
You Have
8+ years of experience as a Facility Security Officer or in a substantially similar industrial security role within a cleared defense contractor environment.
Deep working knowledge of the NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117), DAAPM/Risk Management Framework, and DCSA oversight processes.
Demonstrated experience managing or supporting FOCI mitigation instruments (PA, Security Control Agreement (SCA), Special Security Agreement (SSA), or equivalent). Experience with proxy-agreement structures specifically is strongly preferred.
Proficiency with JPAS, DISS, and eQIP/SF-86 processing.
Active U.S. Government security clearance (Top Secret required); ability to obtain and maintain clearance at the level required for the role.
Demonstrated ability to operate independently and to enforce compliance boundaries with affiliate and parent company personnel. This role requires someone who is genuinely comfortable saying no when the rules require it.
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in a FOCI-mitigated environment at a commercial software or technology company, particularly one with active DSCA oversight.
Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.
Familiarity with ITAR/EAR export control compliance as applied to software and SaaS products.
Industrial Security Professional (ISP) or similar certification.
Experience managing COMSEC accounts or working in a multi-facility environment.
You are
A compliance enforcer who leads with credibility, you've built a reputation for holding firm on security boundaries, even when it creates friction with senior stakeholders or affiliate personnel, and you do so with professionalism and clear regulatory grounding.
Independently operating and self-directing, you're comfortable owning a program end-to-end without a security team beneath you, proactively identifying gaps, drafting policies, and driving decisions without waiting for organizational scaffolding to be built around you.
Deeply fluent in FOCI mitigation frameworks, you're familiar with applying Proxy Agreement or Security Control Agreement structures to day-to-day operational decisions, including managing visit controls, affiliate communications, and annual DCSA reporting obligations.
A trusted cross-functional partner, you work naturally alongside legal counsel, General Managers, and executive governance bodies like a GSC, translating dense regulatory requirements into clear guidance that non-security stakeholders can act on.
Familiar with applying export control frameworks to technology products, you understand how ITAR and EAR obligations intersect with software or SaaS environments and can partner with counsel to ensure compliance without blocking the business from operating effectively.
Measures of Success
Within your first month, you will immerse yourself in CPS's existing Proxy Agreement, Affiliated Operations Plan, and all DCSA-mandated records, establish relationships with the Government Security Committee and key stakeholders, and conduct a comprehensive gap assessment of current FOCI compliance posture and personnel security rosters.
Within your third month, you will take full ownership of DCSA communications and annual compliance reporting, implement or strengthen visit controls and the Electronic Communications and Technology Control Plans, and launch a refreshed security education and awareness training program for cleared and uncleared personnel.
Within your sixth month, you will have matured the Insider Threat Program into a fully operational multi-disciplinary hub with established reporting mechanisms, completed a self-inspection cycle in preparation for DCSA facility reviews, and embedded yourself as a trusted advisor to the GSC on all security, ITAR/EAR, and FOCI mitigation matters, setting the long-term compliance foundation for CPS's growth in the public sector.
Compensation for this role
The standard base salary range for this position is $184,000.00 - $230,000.00 per year. This position is not eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.
In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.
Benefits at Collibra
Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits .
We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.
At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.
With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

What You’ll Do
AI Enablement Roadmap: Own and continuously evolve the roadmap for AI-driven enablement initiatives, prioritizing based on field impact, feasibility, and alignment with broader Enterprise AI team and strategy..
AI Field Use Cases: Identify, scope, and execute on high-value AI use cases for the field (e.g., deal support, prospecting, content generation, guided selling, skills, change management), working with stakeholders to define success criteria and measure impact.
AI Field Champions: build relationships with champions in the field organization to activate power-usage and drive peer-led adoption; track this adoption (e.g., usage, proficiency, behavior change) with our AI Ops Specialist and Enablement Analyst.
Ops Transformation Plan: Design and drive the operational plan that turns AI pilots into scaled, repeatable processes, coordinating across enablement, ops, and technical teams to remove execution bottlenecks.
AI Governance: Influence and lead governance standards for AI tool adoption in the field, including data usage, risk review, tool vetting, and alignment with company-wide AI policy.
What You’ll Bring
Mid-Senior Experience: Several years of experience in enablement, sales operations, or a related GTM function, with a track record of owning initiatives end-to-end.
AI Solutions Experience: Direct experience evaluating, piloting, or deploying AI tools or solutions in a business context, with a solid technical understanding of how they work and where they add value. Act as the field's primary advocate for AI tools (e.g., AI-assisted prospecting, call intelligence, forecasting copilots, RFP/proposal generation).
Cross-Functional Fluency: Proven ability to work closely with product and engineering teams, translating field needs into technical requirements and vice versa.
Self-Sufficiency: Comfortable operating with significant autonomy — able to define scope, structure ambiguous problems, and drive work forward without needing detailed direction.
Organization & Execution: Strong project management instincts; able to manage multiple workstreams (roadmap, use cases, ops transformation, governance) in parallel without dropping details.
Innovative Mindset: A builder's orientation toward new technology — curious about what's possible, willing to experiment, and able to separate genuine opportunity from hype.
Enablement/Sales Background: Familiarity with field or sales enablement motions (onboarding, tool adoption, content, coaching) and how AI can realistically augment them.
GitLab Values Alignment: Ability to work in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, leaning heavily on transparency and collaboration as defined in the GitLab Handbook.
About the team
The Enablement & AI function is part of the CRO organization. Enablement is instrumental in helping GitLab grow at a more accelerated pace and achieve our ambitious revenue targets. The enablement organization comprises enablement leads serving the CRO business functions, a centralized content group, AI tech resources, and an operations team.

title: Coinbase: Derivative Sales Analyst
description:
Headquarters: Remote - UK
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
As a Derivative Sales Analyst on the Institutional team, you'll own and grow relationships with Coinbase's top VIP derivatives traders, driving volume across futures, options, and perpetuals. You'll source new high-value traders from competitor venues, re-engage dormant accounts, and bring structured market and client insights back to Product, Risk, and Marketing to shape Coinbase Advanced trading offerings.
What you'll do:
Own and grow relationships with top VIP derivatives traders on Coinbase, driving increased trading volume, deepening engagement, and expanding adoption of advanced trading products.
Source and convert new high-value derivatives traders from competitor venues through targeted outbound campaigns, market positioning, and relationship-building.
Monitor derivatives market structure, client flows, and competitor offerings to identify upsell opportunities, inform pricing and product feedback, and deliver structured insights to Product, Risk, and Marketing.
Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast for your book, reporting on key KPIs (volume, active traders, winbacks, competitor migration) and documenting client interactions through CRM tooling.
Reactivate previously dormant top traders using data-driven tools and bespoke incentives to restore sustained volume.
Build and refine AI-powered workflows for pipeline prioritization, client segmentation, and outreach personalization to scale coverage across your book.
Required Skills and Experience:
2+ years of sales or business development experience in financial services, trading, or crypto, with a track record of hitting or exceeding revenue and volume targets.
Demonstrated fluency in derivatives products (futures, options, perps) in traditional finance or crypto markets, evidenced by prior trading desk, brokerage, or exchange experience.
Data-driven operating style with experience using dashboards, CRMs, and basic analytics to segment books, identify opportunities, and prioritize outreach.
Background in business, finance, economics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience working directly with trading clients.
Pre-existing network of active institutional derivatives traders you can bring to the platform on day one is preferred.
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Why do you want this new job
description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â
In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:
Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.
Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.
Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.
Iâm looking for more challenging work.
All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills
Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.
About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.
If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.
About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.
Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.
In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

description:
