Join an innovative AI initiative dedicated to improving how advanced AI systems understand, interpret, and reason about legal concepts. We are seeking experienced legal professionals to contribute their real-world expertise by evaluating AI-generated content, providing subject-matter guidance, and helping develop more accurate and reliable AI solutions for legal applications.
This is a flexible, fully remote, part-time opportunity requiring approximately 10 hours per week, with the potential for continued engagement based on project needs and performance.
Key Responsibilities
Review and evaluate AI-generated legal content, written materials, and responses for accuracy, completeness, and quality.
Answer legal questions and provide clear, well-reasoned feedback based on your professional expertise and practical experience.
Identify and recommend authoritative legal references, research materials, and resources relevant to your area of practice.
Share insights into real-world legal workflows, professional standards, research methods, and day-to-day legal practice.
Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of subject matter experts to improve AI performance across a variety of legal domains.
Help ensure AI-generated legal outputs align with professional standards, sound legal reasoning, and practical application. Required Qualifications
Active admission to at least one United States State Bar.
Minimum 2 years of professional legal experience, preferably across multiple practice areas such as contracts, litigation, corporate law, intellectual property, or regulatory and compliance.
Strong proficiency in legal research using standard legal resources, including case law databases, statutes, regulations, and legal treatises.
Excellent written communication skills with the ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly and accurately.
Experience creating legal content such as briefs, memoranda, legal opinions, CLE materials, or similar documentation is a plus.

Based in the United States.
Professional proficiency in English.

Interest in the intersection of law, technology, and artificial intelligence. Why Join
Help shape the future of AI-powered legal technology.
Apply your legal expertise to improve the quality, accuracy, and reliability of AI-generated legal content.

title: Program & Events Coordinator
description:
About the LSPA: The LSP Association (LSPA) is a non-profit association for Massachusetts Licensed Site Professionals (LSPs) and other related environmental practitioners who work on behalf of property owners, operators, and other involved parties to assess and cleanup oil and hazardous materials (OHM) released to the environment. LSPs are licensed by the Commonwealth to oversee this work and, since 1993, over 40,000 contaminated properties have been brought into regulatory compliance.
The LSPA's mission is to support our membership in achieving and maintaining a high standard of practice in the assessment and remediation of contaminated sites in Massachusetts and New England. The LSPA provides technical and educational resources to our membership in the form of programming, networking events, committees, and resources. The LSPA also serves as an advocate to the profession with MassDEP, the LSP Board of Registration, and the state legislature, and as a resource to the public.
Job Description: The Program & Events Coordinator plays a critical role in the success of the LSPA and serves as a primary point of contact for our members, volunteers, and sponsors. This individual is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the association's educational programs and networking events, administering the sponsorship program, and providing customer service support. Success in this position means delivering high-quality member experiences, maintaining strong relationships with volunteers and sponsors, and ensuring the smooth administration of our continuing education program.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously. This individual enjoys working independently while collaborating closely with volunteers, board members, speakers, sponsors, and staff.
Key Responsibilities:
Educational Programs : Coordinate, plan, and manage programs and speakers for all LSPA courses, membership meetings, emerging professional events, the Annual Fall Party, and the Environmental Symposium. The LSPA hosts one to three events per month with 25-250 people in attendance. Approximately 65% of programming is hosted virtually. Content creation is performed in conjunction with input from the Executive Director, Committee Chairs, Education Committee, and Board of Directors.
Event Logistics: For in-person events, source event venues and help facilitate contracts; plan food and beverage, room set-up, and audiovisual needs; reconcile venue bills; and serve as the point of contact on-site. For virtual programs, setup and run the virtual meeting platform, monitor attendance and engagement, create moderator scripts and slides, and train speakers on how to use the virtual platform.
Continuing Education (CE) Administration : Compile CE materials for all educational courses and meetings; submit materials for credit approval with the LSP Board of Registration, the Connecticut Licensed Environmental Professional (LEP) Board, and other Boards/entities; maintain CE records related to attendance, engagement, and evaluation; issue certificates of attendance to attendees; and attend monthly virtual LSP Board of Registration meetings.
Sponsorship : Help administer the corporate and event sponsorship program, including updating the sponsorship prospectus, facilitating invoices/payments, maintaining contact lists, conducting outreach, and working with sponsors to access their sponsorship benefits.
Member Service and Organizational Support : Help monitor and respond to inquiries received through the organization email inbox; provide customer service to members, sponsors, speakers, and event attendees; attend Board meetings, leadership meetings, and committee meetings as requested; and support association operations and special projects as needed.
Qualifications
The person hired for this role should have the following qualifications:
Experience:
2-5 years of experience in program/event planning, project management, or another related field.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and proven ability to provide excellent customer service.
Strong project management skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines independently.
Comfortable coordinating, building relationships with, and communicating professionally with members, volunteers, sponsors, vendors, and other external stakeholders/partners.
Technology:
Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Zoom Meetings and Zoom Webinar, including coordinating presenters from multiple locations, incorporating polling, and managing technical issues.
Association management systems (AMS) or member databases.
Online registration and evaluation platforms.
Canva or similar design tools (preferred, not required).
Preferred Qualifications (not required):
Experience working for a nonprofit organization, professional association, or membership-based organization.
Experience with the environmental sciences industry.
Familiarity with sponsorship development or relationship management.
Bachelor's degree, Associate's degree with relevant experience, or significant relevant professional experience demonstrating the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the position successfully.
Why Join the LSPA?
This is an opportunity to work with a respected association that supports environmental professionals making a meaningful impact on public health and environmental protection throughout Massachusetts and New England. As a small organization, we offer autonomy, flexibility, and the opportunity to build relationships with industry leaders while helping shape the educational and professional development experiences of our members. Compensation and benefits include:
Salary : The salary range for this position is $70,000â$80,000 annually. Compensation will be based on a variety of factors such as individual qualifications and experience.
Benefits : LSPA employees receive $300 per month for a Healthcare Reimbursement Account (HRA) that may be used to reimburse certain medical and insurance-related expenses. The organization does not currently offer group health or dental insurance plans. In addition, employees have access to a 401(k) plan.
PTO : 15 days of paid time off (PTO) annually for the first three years (increases to 20 days thereafter). The LSPA also provides 14 holidays per year (inclusive of 5 floating holidays).
Fully remote position : Candidates may reside anywhere in New England, with preference given to Massachusetts-based applicants. Travel to Massachusetts-based programs and events approximately 10â12 times annually is required.
Reimbursement for home office expenses : $750 annually.
How to Apply
Please submit a cover letter and resume to mmorris@lspa.org. Applications without cover letters or that request compensation/benefits beyond what we can provide will not be reviewed.
The LSPA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, contact mmorris@lspa.org.
The LSPA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

title: Chief of Staff the CEO
description:
The job in one line
You run the CEO's operating system: goals, cadence, and follow-through. You also personally own the projects that don't have a home yet.
Everyday Dose is moving fast in a lot of directions at once. The constraint isn't ideas or effort. It's making sure the right handful of things get set, tracked, and actually finished while everything else keeps running.
That's this job. It is not an executive assistant role and it is not a note-taking role. You'll own outcomes, run the meeting the leadership team is accountable to, and have a real seat.
What You'll Actually Do
Own goal setting. Run quarterly and annual planning end to end. Sit with each exec, turn intent into targets that are measurable and few. Hold the line when a goal is a paragraph instead of a number. Publish it so the whole company knows what we're playing for.
Manage against those goals. Goals decay the week after they're written unless someone owns them. You're that someone. You track progress, surface slippage early, and escalate the things that need the CEO before they become fires.
Run the weekly leadership meeting. Set the agenda, bring the numbers, drive to decisions. Every meeting ends with owners and dates, and you chase them down between meetings. You're not the scribe; you're the person who makes the hour worth everyone's time.
Keep the scoreboard honest. Build and maintain the company-level reporting leadership runs on, in partnership with finance and data. Numbers come from the warehouse, not from someone's recollection on a call. If two sources disagree, you're the one who reconciles them.
Run special projects. The high-stakes, cross-functional thing that has no owner: a new bet, a partnership, a channel or business we're deciding whether to enter, a problem that spans three teams and belongs to none of them. You get handed ambiguity and come back with an answer, a model, and a plan.
Be the CEO's second read. Pressure-test decisions before they're made. Prep board and investor materials. Write the memo when the thinking needs to be sharp. Say the thing nobody else in the room will say.
What Success Looks Like In 90 Days
Company goals for the quarter are written, owned, and measurable, and every leader can recite theirs without opening a doc
The weekly leadership meeting has a repeatable format, a live scoreboard, and decisions that stick
One company-level dashboard everyone trusts, sourced from the warehouse
Two special projects taken from ambiguous to finished without supervision
The CEO's time visibly reallocated toward the highest-leverage work in the business
Requirements
What we're looking for
8 to 12 years of experience, including time as a Chief of Staff, BizOps lead, Strategy & Operations lead, or equivalent to a founder/CEO or a senior exec
Top pedigree. Strong academic background and time at companies with a known high bar, plus a record of being promoted inside them. We look hard at both
Left brain. You're fluent in a spreadsheet and comfortable in a data environment. You can build a model, size an opportunity, read a cohort curve, and pull your own numbers rather than filing a ticket and waiting
Right brain. You write exceptionally well. Memos, board decks, exec comms. You can take a messy 90-minute discussion and turn it into one page that changes what people do
You've run an operating cadence (OKRs or equivalent, weekly business reviews, planning cycles) at a company doing real volume, not as a theory from a deck
Backbone. You will regularly tell senior, accomplished people that their goal isn't measurable or their project is late. You do it without drama and without flinching, and they respect you for it
Startup metabolism. High ambiguity, fast context switching, nothing beneath you. You'd rather own the outcome than protect the org chart
You use AI tooling daily to move faster on analysis, drafting, and research
Bonus
DTC, subscription, or CPG experience, especially a business with recurring revenue and real retention mechanics
Consulting, banking, or PE foundation plus real operating experience (we're not looking for one without the other)
You've built materials for and presented to a board or investors
SQL, or enough of it to be dangerous
What this role is not
Not an executive assistant. You are not managing a calendar or booking travel
Not a project manager who takes notes and updates a tracker
Not a strategy role that stops at the recommendation
Not a functional leadership role. You won't inherit a team on day one, though this role can grow into one
If you want a clear lane and a stable scope, this isn't it, and that's fine.
How To Apply
Skip the cover letter. Instead, send us:
One page on an operating cadence you built or ran. What existed before, what you changed, and what measurably improved as a result
A time you told an executive something they didn't want to hear. What you said, and what happened
Short answer: A subscription business is seeing retention slip. Five executives each have a confident, different theory as to why. You have two weeks. What do you look at first, how do you get to the actual answer, and how do you land it with a leadership team that's already made up its mind?
We read these carefully. Applications without them won't move forward.
Benefits
Strong base, performance bonus
Meaningful equity because we want you to own a piece of what you build
Health benefits + health stipend
Generous time off
Free product

description:
Oula delivers maternity care built around our patientsâoffering comprehensive support before, during, and after pregnancy. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach is delivering better outcomes. Our team of trusted midwives, OBGYNs, and dedicated care navigators ensure our patients get the type of care they need in the moments that matter most.
Since launching in 2021, weâve expanded to include Preconception and Miscarriage Care, Pregnancy Care, Postpartum Support, and Gynecology. We currently have 4 clinics in the tri-state area, with three new clinics opening in 2026! Come join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.
OULA HEALTH
Product Manager
Full-Time
New York, Chicago or Charlotte
Reports to VP, Central Operations
About Oula
Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. We partner exclusively with major health systems â including Mount Sinai, Stamford Health, and Novant Health â to embed our collaborative OB-GYN and midwifery model directly inside their networks. We're a team of ~100 people at Series B stage, with 4 clinics today and three more opening in 2026.
The Role
At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR â it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.
We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack â including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.
You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver. You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. When things are ambiguous (and they often are), you'll lean in rather than wait for clarity.
What You'll Own
EHR Configuration & Clinical Systems
Own day-to-day management of our core tech stack: the EHR, patient portal, and care management platform
Own Athena and Epic configuration end to end: clinical templates, order sets, lab configurations, payer connectivity, and access management for clinical and ops staff
Lead EHR integration efforts as the internal and external subject matter expert â FHIR/HL7 data exchange, health system IT coordination and committed go-live timelines
Own and accelerate Epic integration timelines as we onboard additional health system partners
Maintain configuration integrity as new markets launch and care model workflows evolve
Partner with our IT team on infrastructure; own the clinical systems layer they don't touch
Product Operations & Launch
Own bug intake and prioritization from Market Operations â standardize how Engineering receives, scopes, and resolves issues and communicates status back to the field
Build structured launch toolkits and training materials so clinic teams are prepared for new feature rollouts on day one
Coordinate end-to-end launches across Product, Engineering, and Operations
Identify where AI and automation can reduce manual administrative burden in product operations workflows
Standards & Knowledge Management
Build and maintain the clinical systems SOP library so new market setup is repeatable â documented well enough that a new hire can execute without you in the room
Develop onboarding materials for clinic managers and clinical staff on EHR workflows and tooling
Drive feature parity efforts so patients and clinicians experience a consistent standard of care across markets
Data & Reporting
Build and maintain dashboards tracking feature adoption, issue resolution, and rollout health across clinics
Develop quarterly reporting for Product, leadership, and health system partners on platform performance
Ensure data infrastructure is in place to measure the impact of every feature rollout
What You Bring
3+ years with product operations, technical program management, or PM-adjacent work â ideally at a growth-stage digital health or services company
Strong problem-solving instincts and genuine curiosity â you like figuring out how things work and making them work better
Ease with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this role requires you to create the playbook, not execute someone else's
Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive aggressive timelines â ideally with client-facing or health system-facing experience
Ability to speak âmultiple languagesâ â comfort going deep on technical details while communicating clearly to non-technical audiences; you can write a bug ticket, an SOP, and a launch plan that people actually follow; hands-on EHR configuration and integration experience strongly preferred
Analytical enough to build a dashboard and identify a pattern, even if you're not a SQL expert
What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.
At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.
At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.
Compensation & Details
Salary: $110,000 â $140,000 depending on experience and location
Equity: Options commensurate with level
Location: Preference for New York/New Jersey/Connecticut, Chicago or Charlotte Remote-flexible with periodic travel to clinic locations and health system partners
Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision; 401(k); generous PTO
Oula offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, and comprehensive benefits. Exact compensation inclusive of salary and any bonuses is determined based on a number of factors including experience and skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Oula is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone's contributions are valued.
Salary Range: $110,000 USD - $140,000 USD
Oula's Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer :
We want you to know: You can be a great candidate even if you don't fit everything we've described above. You can also have important skills we haven't thought of. If that's you, don't hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself (especially in your cover letter â this is where you can really state your case for *why you*). We are committed to fostering diversity in our organization and building an equitable and inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and experiences. We're taking steps to meet that commitment. We especially encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, people of color, LGBTQ people, veterans, and people with disabilities.

About Us
Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations. About the Role
MrBeast is looking for a data-driven, creative, and fast-paced Video Editor to join our Content & Post-Production team working on the MrBeast Reacts channel. This role is for a master-level editor who lives and breathes YouTube culture, capable of transforming raw multi-cam reaction feeds into hyper-engaging content that keeps millions of viewers locked in. You will thrive in a high-feedback environment, balancing aggressive production schedules with a relentless obsession for frame-by-frame pacing and audience retention. What You'll Do
Cut and assemble raw multi-cam reaction footage, seamlessly balancing primary talent commentary, PIP source media, and visual punch-ins.
Engineer high-retention video intros and hooks that immediately fulfill title and thumbnail promises within the first 30 seconds.
Execute hyper-fast pacing, comedic timing, and visual pop-ups, including kinetic typography, memes, and custom tracking graphics.
Perform high-quality sound design, including impactful SFX, dynamic music ducking, and precise audio balancing for voice clarity.
Collaborate closely with Lead Editors and creative teams to incorporate rapid turnaround notes and feedback loops.
Analyze YouTube retention curves alongside lead editors to pinpoint drop-off moments and refine pacing rules for subsequent edits.
Maintain clean, highly organized timeline projects in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, adhering to internal post-production standards.
Coordinate with the thumbnail team to ensure visual assets and key video climaxes align perfectly with channel creative strategy.

A data-driven mindset that prioritizes viewer retention evidence over personal creative assumptions.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
Job Title:
Area Sales Manager
Reports to:
Director of Sales- East
Location:
Remote- New York Metro
Status:
FT/Exempt
Compensation:
$70,000 â $80,000 annual base salary, plus a competitive bonus opportunity. Final compensation will be commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications.
ABOUT THE COMPANY
ROAR is redefining hydration for a new generation. In a category that has become overly serious and hardcore performance obsessed, ROAR stands for something different: hydration that is expressive, effortless, and rooted in real life. Built for people who move, connect, and live life out loud, ROAR delivers complete hydration with vitamins, antioxidants, and electrolytes - all with just 20 calories and 3g of sugar or less per bottle.
More than a beverage, ROAR is a cultural signal - bright, approachable, and fun. It rejects the intensity and rules of traditional hydration in favor of something more human: joy, spontaneity, and the kind of movement that doesnât need a scoreboard. This positioning has resonated with consumers and retailers alike driving strong momentum across both natural and conventional retail, where ROAR continues to expand rapidly and now ranks as the #2 brand in the natural channel within the enhanced water category.
ROLE OVERVIEW
ROAR Organic is seeking a hands-on Sales Leader to drive profitable growth in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role is responsible for leading all sales activities across grocery customers in the New York Metro area, including new business development, key account management, and executing data-driven strategies to expand market share and increase brand awareness.
The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of scaling high-growth brands profitably, with experience managing both established and emerging grocery retailers, as well as partners. They are highly relationship-driven, resourceful, and action-oriented, with strong communication and organizational skills. This leader excels at building and implementing the strategies, tools, and processes needed to support sustained growth.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Deliver against Annual Operating Plan targets, including gross/net sales and trade spend objectives.
Grow distribution and topline revenue with a focus on regional and independent retailers.
Execute customer sales strategies, promotional calendars, and account plans.
Leverage distributer incentive programs and independent retailer promotional opportunities to drive sales.
Conduct weekly route rides with distributor sales representatives to support execution and identify growth opportunities.
Develop and own a field execution strategy based on weekly trend reports, promotional planners, and merchandising opportunities.
Manage and execute trade spend programs to drive profitable growth and promotional effectiveness.
Leverage syndicated data (IRI, SPINS) to communicate compelling, retailer-specific presentations.
Track, measure, and analyze performance metrics, including ROI.
Represent the brand at regional and national trade shows, customer meetings, and industry events.
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
Minimum 2 years of CPG sales experience.
Strong understanding of the beverage and grocery landscape, including retailers and distributors.
Experience executing sales planning initiatives.
Creative, solutions-oriented problem solver with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Thrives in a hands-on, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with syndicated data tools (SPINS, IRI) preferred.
Ability to travel extensively as needed.
Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
Ability to lift up to 30 pounds.
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship.

title: Sales & Marketing Director
description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.
This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.
During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.
The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.
About The Role
Mission Statement
The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.
You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.
As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.
General Responsibilities
Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
Directly reporting to Company Leadership
Position Specs
Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring
Requirements
About You
Profile
The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.
You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.
You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.
The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.
Key Requirements
At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

title: Brand Designer
description:
About Symbiotic
Symbiotic is the infrastructure beneath collateral markets, where capital can secure financial obligations, remain productive, and be enforced by code.
By changing the economics of onchain collateral, Symbiotic enables new categories of neofinance applications that were previously impossible to build - including credit, insurance, RWA liquidity, and more.
As institutional capital increasingly moves onchain, Symbiotic is positioned to become the coordination layer connecting capital and risk across the onchain economy.
Backed by Paradigm, Pantera, Cyber.fund, and Coinbase Ventures, we power 80+ vaults, 74,000+ active stakers, and 111 operators - with Chainlink, Nexus Mutual, and Cap Labs among the teams live in production.
See how Symbiotic is powering the next generation of onchain finance: symbiotic.fi
Our People
Weâre a tight-knit team of experienced builders working at the forefront of financial infrastructure. Our backgrounds span high-growth tech start-ups, leading crypto companies, major banks, insurers, and financial institutions. We work with ownership, a high bar for craft, and the urgency of an early-stage company - in an environment where people are trusted to take initiative and supported to do their best work.
Weâre looking for talented professionals to join us at a defining moment, as Symbiotic helps shape the next generation of onchain finance.
What You'll Do
Own visual output across brand, campaigns, web, social, and launch moments, from concept to shipped asset.
Turn complex financial infrastructure and products into things people can actually see and understand.
Set and hold the visual system as we scale, not just as a guideline doc, but as consistent, recognisable output across everything we ship.
Support event and content collateral: Prepares high-impact visuals for Web3 conferences, whitepaper illustrations, and blog graphics .
Optimize assets for Web3 platforms: Ensures designs are responsive for web3 wallets, mobile apps, and animated formats, while adhering to crypto-specific trends.
Produce motion and 3D work where it earns its place: product explainers, launch films, conference presence.
Who You Are
Fast and good, not one or the other. Most designers have one. You have both and you can walk us through the timeline on specific pieces in your portfolio: how long it took, what the deadline was, what you cut.
Deep in one or two areas, competent across the rest. Strong in brand or motion or 3D, able to hold your own in the others.
Self-directed. You've scoped, sequenced, and driven real projects without someone telling you the next step and made the calls yourself when the brief was ambiguous.
Someone who pitches rather than asks permission. You bring a direction and argue for it.
Unbothered by direct feedback. We're small, fast, and radically transparent with each other.
Sitting on a portfolio with real range. You shipped work, not concepts, ideally something you took from nothing to live under time pressure.
Nice to have
Crypto, fintech experience â enough that you're not learning what a protocol is on the job.
In-house experience at an early-stage company.
3D or motion as a genuine strength rather than a passing familiarity.

description:
Transportation Analyst
Location: Charlotte, NC, USA, remote
Work Location: remote local
Have you ever enjoyed ArnoldÂ®, BrownberryÂ® or OroweatÂ® bread? A ThomasâÂ® English muffin or bagel? Or perhaps snacked on a Sara LeeÂ®, EntenmannâsÂ® or MarinelaÂ® cake or donut? If the answer is yes, then you know Bimbo Bakeries USA!
More than 20,000 associates in bakeries, sales centers, offices and on sales routes work to ensure our consumers have the freshest products at every meal. In addition to competitive pay and benefits, we provide a safe and inclusive work environment that appreciates diversity, promotes development and allows our associates to be their authentic selves.
## LI-NP1
Come join the largest baking company in the world and our family of 20,000 associates nationwide!
Top Reasons To Work At Bimbo Bakeries USA
Salary Range: $56,500 - $73,400
Annual Bonus Eligibility
Comprehensive Benefits Package
Paid Time Off
401k & Company Match
Position Summary:
The Transportation Analyst supports transportation planning, daily shipment execution, customer service, and performance reporting across the transportation network. This role combines analytical problem solving with service-oriented communication to improve shipment visibility, monitor on-time performance, support track-and-trace activity, identify trends and exceptions, and provide timely reporting and follow-up to carriers, internal stakeholders, and operations teams.
Key Responsibilities
Support transportation planning activities by reviewing shipment demand, routing requirements, carrier capacity, delivery schedules, and operational constraints.
Monitor shipment execution through track-and-trace activity, providing timely updates on shipment status, delivery expectations, appointment changes, and potential service risks.
Provide customer service support to carriers, internal teams, and business partners by responding to transportation inquiries, resolving shipment issues, and coordinating follow-up on exceptions.
Track, analyze, and report transportation KPIs including on-time pickup, on-time delivery, appointment adherence, shipment visibility, exception resolution time, carrier response time, and service issue trends.
Prepare on-time performance reporting and provide analysis on delays, missed appointments, late deliveries, root causes, and opportunities to improve service performance.
Analyze transportation data to identify trends, cost impacts, service gaps, network inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve planning, execution, and carrier performance.
Partner with Transportation, Planning, Logistics, Operations, Sales, Customer Service, and carrier partners to support daily execution, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Request, validate, and maintain accurate shipment, carrier, and transportation data to support reporting, performance analysis, and operational decision-making.
Review transportation reports and data for inconsistencies, missing information, shipment exceptions, and documentation gaps; seek clarification as needed to ensure accurate reporting and follow-up.
Assist with business cases, savings projections, operating budgets, and project start-ups by providing transportation data, KPI insights, and performance analysis.
Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying process gaps, recommending improvements, and helping standardize transportation planning, reporting, and communication processes.
Serve as cross-functional support for transportation planning and execution activities as needed to ensure operational continuity and consistent service levels.
Leadership Competencies
Education and Work History:
3-5 yearsâ experience in Supply Chain/Transportation Analysis in CPG, Food Beverage or Third Party Logistics company.
Understanding of the North American transportation industry including dedicated/private fleet, TL, LTL (domestic and cross border), intermodal.
Highly proficient / advanced working knowledge in Microsoft Office (ie: Word, Excel, Access, Outlook, PowerPoint).
Experience/Exposure with logistics optimization tools (routing, transportation planning software) such as Appian, Paragon, JDA/Bule Yonder is a definite asset.
Working knowledge of TMS (Specially Oracle TMS) is an asset.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly.
Strong customer service mindset with the ability to support carrier partners, internal stakeholders, and operations teams by proactively addressing service issues, communicating changes, and coordinating resolution of transportation exceptions.
Ability to work with and support all team members, management and shareholders.

title: VP Revenue
description:
Mongoose is the leading AI Engagement Platform in higher education. Colleges and universities use us to increase enrollment, retention, and fundraising — without adding staff.
We have the product and the customers. What we don't have yet is a revenue engine to match. That's this role. As VP of Revenue, you own it end to end — new business, client success, account management, and, most importantly, the system that ties them together. Your job is to make it simple and run it with discipline.
What You'll Do
Own all of revenue. The whole revenue org reports to you — one team, one leader. New business, client success, and account management are the front line, with enablement and operations behind them — the training and tools that set them up to win. It all serves one goal: grow ARR — by winning new business and helping our customers succeed. So you're measured on two things: new ARR and gross retention.
Build a simple, repeatable selling system. One clear path from first call to close to renewal — the stages, standards, and playbooks the whole team runs the same way. Make it so clear that reps know what good looks like and spend their time selling, not guessing. Done right, it shows up in forecasts you can trust, faster deals, and better conversion at every step.
Grow the people who sell it. Our reps are early in their careers and hungry, so growing them isn't a side project — it's the job. You build the system that does it: ramp, enablement, and a steady coaching cadence. And you're in it, not above it — in the deals and the reviews, helping close and coaching the fundamentals in the moment, not from a slide at quarter's end. The result is reps who sell with real confidence and conviction: they know how to win, and they believe they will.
Move us up-market. Our next stage of growth is in bigger deals. You know where the real opportunity lives in higher ed, and you focus the team there — raising the ACV we pursue, building around the highest-value accounts, and growing the ones with real upside. It takes sharp market judgment, a head for the numbers, and the discipline to say no to deals that aren't worth the team's time.
Run revenue like an AI company. Most revenue orgs still operate the way they did decades ago — we won't. We sell AI for a living, and the whole company is getting far more efficient, accurate, and effective by letting AI do the manual work. That takes more than watching for the next AI tool — it takes imagination: you picture how technology could reinvent the work, then we build it.
What You'll Bring
You've run a full revenue org — new business and retention both — and carried a number yourself, not just managed people who carried theirs.
When a number gets missed, you go straight to the funnel math — pipeline, conversion, time-in-stage — not the story about why.
You've built a selling system that works — whether you stood it up from scratch or overhauled a broken one inside an established org.
You're a real coach. You've taken early-career reps and turned them into closers — hands-on, not from a dashboard.
You think in unit economics and read a market fast. You've moved a team toward bigger, better deals, and had the discipline to walk from the rest.
You're already using AI to reinvent how you work, and you don't wait for permission to push it further.
Higher ed or EdTech experience is a strong plus, not a must. The market has real nuance — if you haven't lived in it, show us how you'll close the gap fast.
How We Work Revenue doesn't run in isolation. You're a key member of our senior leadership team — leading revenue alongside the CEO, partnering with Product and Marketing on go-to-market, and with Finance and People to run the business. Tight feedback loops, honest calls, shared decisions. We hold each other accountable to the plan — and to the whole outcome, not just our own lane.
More About Mongoose
1,000+ higher ed institutions already trust Mongoose — built to give their teams exponentially more capacity across the systems they already run.
AI handles the routine, so people can focus on the work that actually moves students forward — more applications completed, more students retained, more donors reached. Same team. Much bigger impact.
What We Offer
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
401K with company match: 100% of the 1st 3% and 50% of the next 2%
Flexible PTO
Competitive Leave Policies
13 paid holidays, including a week off between Christmas and New Year’s
The Basics Remote, anywhere in the US. Some travel — for customers, for big deals, and for time together as a team.
At Mongoose, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and inclusion builds stronger teams. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know—we’re here to help.

title: Entry Level Junior Trader
description:
ATOM Partners is an international company focused on digital asset markets, trading technologies, and data-driven market research. We work with modern analytical tools and help aspiring professionals build practical knowledge of cryptocurrency trading in a structured environment.
We are currently looking for an Entry Level Junior Trader to join our growing remote team. This opportunity is designed for motivated individuals who are interested in financial markets, cryptocurrency, and analytical thinking. Previous professional trading experience is not required â we provide comprehensive training and continuous guidance throughout the onboarding process.

Our focus is on developing your practical trading abilities in live crypto markets. No previous work experience is needed â we provide complete training.
Key Responsibilities
Place buy and sell orders in cryptocurrency markets while following risk rules and basic strategies.
Watch real-time price changes, trading volumes, and order book movements.
Use charts, technical indicators, and market signals to guide trade entries and exits.
Keep track of active positions and assess potential gains or losses.
Follow crypto news and understand how events may affect prices.
Work with industry-standard trading interfaces and analytics dashboards.
Review your own trading results regularly to identify strengths and areas to improve.
Build a deeper understanding of market behavior and trading techniques over time.
Requirements
Basic computer literacy (using browsers, platforms, hotkeys).
Stable internet connection and a laptop or PC.
English at intermediate level or higher (to understand news and interface).
Ability to focus during market hours (flexible, but attentive).
Willingness to learn and ask questions.

100% remote work â you can operate from any location.
Flexible hours and adjustable workload.
Access to professional-grade trading tools and live market data.
Use of advanced analytics and reporting systems.
A clear roadmap for professional growth with increasing responsibility over time.

Hands-on training on professional trading platforms, guided by experienced mentors.

Remote work from anywhere.
Flexible schedule.
Structured training program.
Career development opportunities.
Continuous mentorship.
International team.
Modern analytical tools.

title: Senior Independent Software Developer
description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.
A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing.
After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.
As part of A·Team, you can expect:
High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too.
Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.
How to apply:
Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.
What you’ll do:
Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would
Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team.
You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction.
Who A · Team is for:
Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.
Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.
The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing
Who A · Team is not for:
People looking for small gigs
Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites
Those still early in their careers (
Our long-term vision:
A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams.
To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+ from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

title: Head of Marketing & Communications
description:
We are hiring a Head of Marketing & Communications to tell the garden3d story across the internet, from wherever in the world you happen to be.
More details if you check our original job posting link
About garden3d
We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.
Our client roster includes Google , Stripe , Figma , Hinge , Black Socialists in America , ACLU , Pratt , Parsons , Mozilla , The Nobel Prize , MIT , Gnosis , Etsy & Gagosian .
We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill , and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space .
We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.
Sanctuary Computer — Development
At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.
Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.
XXIX — Design
When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.
We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.
Index Space — Community
A network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.
We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.
garden3d TK — Media
At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.
We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.
Plus, our partner organizations
https://www.thelightphone.com/
https://www.mill.com/
https://www.ingredient-ai.com/
The Head of Marketing & Communications Role
The garden3d Head of Marketing & Communications has one mandate: make sure everything we put on the internet is compelling and interesting. garden3d is a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and each needs its own voice, its own audience, and its own drumbeat of work worth sharing. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis , this person decides what we make, where it runs, and whether it clears our bar.
You can be based anywhere. A lot of our studios, spaces and people gravitate around New York, so there's some pull to be here, and a good part of this job is noticing what's happening in our world and turning it into content. But we already work across timezones, and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.
This role will interface with studio leads, designers, developers, editors, animators, photographers, community managers, event producers and ad platforms across every garden3d vertical.
Simply, this person can easily context shift between our massively diverse set of workstreams, find the most compelling stories, and get them produced at an exceedingly high bar.
This person owns our channels end to end: the garden3d Substack , our podcast, Instagram, X, and the paid accounts behind them. They collab with our team, and a rotating cast of freelance editors, designers and animators, and they run the calendar that keeps a dozen workstreams shipping on time. They think in PESO terms (paid, earned, shared, owned) with the weight on shared and owned media - paid is a tool they use deliberately, and traditional press is a bonus, but not generally where we focus.
The ambition runs past marketing a services business. garden3d TK is our young experimental media company, and this role is its engine: books, screenplays, music, media, activations: a record label for ideas. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, a network of community spaces and an open P&L and sees the best content brief on the internet.
Responsibilities & Mandates
‍ Quality never less than 8/10
We aspire for 10/10, celebrate 9/10 and never publish anything that’s not an 8/10 - visually, narratively, and in production quality. This person holds that bar across every post, video, essay and episode on every vertical, and would rather kill a piece than let a 6 out the door. Their feedback makes work better and faster, without micromanaging the people who make it.
Social That Stops the Scroll
They carry a current, practitioner-level read on how each platform works right now: what arrests someone mid-scroll, how a hook earns the next three seconds, why a format lands on TikTok and dies on LinkedIn. Short-form video is a first-class craft here, not an afterthought.
️ A House of Brands, Each in Its Own Voice
Sanctuary Computer doesn't sound like XXIX, and neither sounds like Index. They manage several messaging columns at once, keeping each brand's tone distinct while the umbrella story stays coherent.
Case Study Production
Every client engagement across our creative agencies should end in a case study worth reading. They own that production line - interviewing the team, shaping the narrative, art-directing the assets - and ship case studies that win each studio its next project.
️ Websites That Put Our Best Foot Forward
Our websites are usually the first place a prospective client or hire meets us. They own the strategy behind every garden3d site - what it says, what work it shows, and how clearly it communicates what each studio can do - and they keep sites, decks and other collateral current as the work moves, so what people find is sharp and true.
️ Editorial Ownership
The Substack , the podcast, and our transparency publications (like the open-source P&L we release every year) are theirs to run: the calendar, the standards, the growth. They capture what happens in our spaces - Index, USB Club, and the communities around them - and turn it into work worth sharing.
Producing, Paid & Distribution
They direct producers, editors and freelancers like a showrunner: briefs are clear, deadlines are real, and many workstreams move at once without dropping quality. They run paid spend on Meta, Instagram and wherever our audiences live - building audiences, running A/B/C tests on both narrative and adset, and owning budgets against results they can show.
Data-Driven Reporting & ROI
They measure what our content actually does - audience growth, engagement, leads, pipeline influenced - and report on it plainly. Paid spend, organic effort and production time all get judged on return, and next quarter's plan follows the numbers.
Presence IRL
garden3d shows up in person: events, conferences, talks, Index programming, and the dinners and openings where our world gathers. They decide which touchpoints are worth our time, get us there looking like ourselves, and bring back stories worth publishing.
Culture
They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The producers and creatives they direct do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is real, and the taste rubs off.
Special Projects
In addition to day to day responsibilities, here’s an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years
Turning garden3d TK into a real experimental media brand: books, screenplays, music, and shows
Growing our podcast into a property with its own audience
Launch campaigns for new Index spaces, USB Club drops, and community programs
Making our annual open-source P&L release a media moment
Standing up a small content studio that serves all four studios' new-business pipelines
Building the systems (and hiring the people) that let us publish more often, while aspiring for a 10/10 content, and never dropping below an 8/10
Qualifications
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:
Must have:
8+ years in marketing, content or brand leadership, with real time inside creative studios, agencies or founder-led companies
A portfolio that proves exceptional taste - visual, narrative, and tone of voice
A design background and/or fluency & comfort producing own visual assets at the required quality level in Figma when necessary
Experience owning a company's web presence: site strategy, messaging, and keeping capabilities collateral current
Exceptional project management: content calendars, production pipelines, many workstreams at once
Short-form video fluency: they've shipped work for Reels, TikTok and Shorts and can say why each piece performed
Extensive experience & comfort managing creatives & producers (editors, designers, animators, freelancers) and getting better work out of them than they'd make alone
Hands-on experience running paid social on Meta, Instagram and other platforms: audience building, budget ownership, and A/B/C testing across narrative and ad set
Working fluency in the PESO model, with a point of view on where paid, earned, shared and owned media each earn their keep
Nice-to-have:
Experience producing a brand's IRL presence: events, conferences, talks, and the follow-through that turns them into content
Podcast or audio production experience
Comfort/experience managing multiple messaging columns in a house of brands
Newsletter growth experience, Substack especially
Community & events marketing: programming, launches, IRL moments
Photography, motion or editing chops of their own
Fluency with AI production tools, plus the judgment to know when not to use them
A press & media network (traditional PR isn't the focus, but relationships help)
Experience marketing to design & engineering decision-makers at companies like our clients
Book publishing or long-form media experience
Experience growing a services business's story into a consumer-scale audience
Who you are
The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart” by carefully managing their workflow and team.
How we interview
After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.
From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.
For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.
Compensation
This role greatly favors autonomous, competent & ambitious operators. It will begin with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $75 - $120 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.
At garden3d, we believe that those who shoulder the most responsibility and create the greatest impact should be paid accordingly.

title: Product Sales Specialist - Pet Health
description:
Must Love Dogs!!
At Tribe Wellness, we're more than just a tribe – we're a movement. Rooted in courage, empowerment, and integrity, we've pioneered solutions that transform the world's wellness brands into revenue-generating machines. We bridge the gap between brands and revenue by turning our clients’ customers into lifetime supporters, and we do that by turning good salespeople into great salespeople.
At Tribe Wellness Sales, we’re on a mission to help pets live longer, healthier lives through supplements that actually deliver. But here’s the catch: too many pet owners grab a product online and then flounder—unsure how to use it or missing the guidance to make it work. That’s where you, our Product Sales Specialist (called a Protocol Review Specialist in our world), make the difference. Without you, pets miss out on better health, owners lose confidence, and our mission stalls. With you? You’re the spark that turns a purchase into a transformation—for pets and their people.
What You'll Do:
Sell: You’ll sell products and services for our pet client, a company built for pet owners, by pet owners, with over a million happy dogs and growing!
Grow: Work with a broad range of potential customers, transforming clients’ prospects into brand loyalists.
Learn: Work closely with our dedicated leaders, leveraging our top-notch training resources to master the art of selling and representing Tribe's ethos.
Earn: Operate with no cap on commission, providing limitless earning potential to integrate with our operations seamlessly.
Live: Work from home in a global remote environment, utilizing our communication tools and platforms.
What's In It For You:
Earnings: This is an hourly pay + commission role. All US sales reps earn minimum wage (this is permanent, not a draw against commission) in addition to sales commissions, based on your monthly sales. On-target-earnings are estimated between $55,000 - $100K your first year. In addition to the above, we offer fully paid training.
Tribe Sales Training: We have a battle-tested training and tool kit we provide for all our sales consultants, including sales training through our learning platform, Rippling, Salesforce, Vonage, Google Workspace, and Slack, ensuring you're primed for success the second you hit the phones.
Remote Work: You’ll have the freedom of a fully remote position, allowing for a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.
Be Part of the Tribe: No matter your title, you’ll join a community that values partnership, advocacy, and growth. We believe in nurturing our team members and fostering an environment of collaboration, support, and mutual success. Check our team success stories here !
What We’re Looking For:
Hard-working and highly driven individuals who embody Tribe's core values.
Knowledge, background, or raw passion around health and wellness.
Experience in sales is an advantage, but with our comprehensive tool kit, we welcome those hungry to learn and grow.
A self-starter, motivated by growth opportunities and the drive to excel in sales.
Excellent verbal and written skills, with top-notch communication skills and a knack for building genuine connections.
You'll need a stable internet connection capable of supporting seamless voice and video communications, and data transfer, with an Octane Speed of 20,000 or greater ( https://chromium.github.io/octane/ ).
A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with a working mic, camera, and a working headset.
The ability to work 40 hours per week (8 hours per day) starting at 8 AM CST.
Join us if you’re ready to play a pivotal role in reshaping the world of pet health and wellness while thriving in a growth-centric global environment with amazing people. If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Take the shot today and work with a very different type of company.

title: Inside Sales Contractor
description:
About Us
We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.
During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!
Compensation Structure
This role is 100% commission-based , which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.
Training Period (Weeks 1–4)
We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:
Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).
Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $1,000 total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.
Week 2: $250 guaranteed minimum
Week 3: $325 guaranteed minimum
Week 4: $425 guaranteed minimum
By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.
Post Training Period:
Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually
Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually
*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.
What will you be doing?
Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.
We are looking for team members who are:
Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.
Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.
Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.
Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.
Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!
Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.
Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!
You will need:
Home office or a quiet place to work.
Strong internet connection.
Desktop or laptop
(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)
Scheduling
Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.
*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.
Post Training:
We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:
Monday - Friday
